limits: Bots are not players: Black no-refill is marginal in Acts II-III, Red is untouched. Fun, fairness and pacing are player gates.

Conductor meter regression was not established in-engine: the chapter_spectacle_lab conductor case starts in a harbour room for the parent too (warp fixture failing here), and no Midnight route reaches the Conductor. Unit tests prove the stub falls through to the published finder outside room 106. Build with --no-meter to drop the meter and leave that path untouched.

chapter_spectacle_lab hoist/hoist-save and chapter_finish_lab save cases use the JIT static-warp fixture, which starts in room 96 in this worktree for the parent too; crane_walk machine is the working path here.
crane_walk entry fails on the published v0.37.0 as well; the full 30-door sweep and midnight_walk all were not completed.
Backup spawn count is the native spawner's roll inside a 30-frame window: one or two Maws.
Act II arrives at two thirds rather than half health because the published marker word was patched; every damaged-phase timing and guard visual follows it.
Cargo drops are agent-tested only; whether the drop reads as spectacle or delay, the size and darkness of the open container and the pace of the arriving crew are player verdicts.

Crown reinforcement was checked by variable trace (and a first-version capture), not by a clean frame sheet: the 1-HP crew in the lab fight fixture sometimes never dies in 1500 frames, the published ROM included.
Crew-active Freight door crossing fails the same way on v0.37.0; the full 30-door sweep, midnight_walk all, save/Continue and the Black no-refill fight on the cargo build were not run.
The published room rosters and budgets already vary per room; the room ramp was not retuned.
rebase: python tools/crane_arm.py --out build/<dir> --source <any later ROM with the published hooks and rooms> builds the same changes with the next minor version (all hook sites, scripts and tables are asserted); built once onto the unpublished boarding candidate, not run in the engine
